scope: Local prepaid escrow and complete 24-layer fixed-point inference; mocked posting-fee precompile
checks: Single runtime deploys locally with the actual pinned kernel and index
All 2016 valid context/maximum-output combinations match independent work and escrow bounds
Out-of-vocabulary prompt is rejected
Context limit is enforced
Underfunded start is rejected
Overpayment is rejected
Stale expected budget is rejected
Plain ETH transfers are rejected
Unfunded legacy start cannot bypass escrow
Absent posting-fee precompile fails closed
Posting fee above requester cap is rejected
Gas price above requester cap is rejected
Only chosen executor can advance
Only requester can cancel
Only requester can replace executor
Real embedding work earns bounded executor credit with an explicit posting fee
Failed refund recipient preserves withdrawal credit
Cancellation refunds unused escrow and both parties can withdraw exactly their credits
One paid continuation per transaction prevents duplicate full-transaction posting reimbursement
Reentrant withdrawal is rejected and contract executors can withdraw
Requester can replace an executor without changing budget or inference state
Finished session cannot execute more inference
Complete inference uses no top-ups; all successful work stays within the on-chain unit and fee bounds
Completion credits exact unused balance; executor and requester withdrawals leave zero liabilities and zero balance
All 24-layer Q32 checkpoint hashes match the independent reference at every processed position
Generated token IDs match the independently validated float32 reference tokens
Every continuation stays within the local 32-million computation cap
posting_precompile: Explicit local mock; no claim of live RH fee behavior
limitations: 64 total prompt and generated tokens; greedy token IDs only
Q32/int16 approximation needs broader quality evaluation
Local gas excludes RH parent posting and live storage pricing effects
Prepaid quote is a conservative fee ceiling, not exact future network gas; it does not guarantee executor availability or completion
Executor billing uses measured in-contract gas plus 120000 allowance; it is not exact receipt reimbursement
Start, cancel, executor change and withdrawal wallet fees are separate; failed calls are not reimbursed
No production deployment, frontend integration, on-chain text tokenizer or agent actions
